pairs.question: A company director is attempting to submit claims for an Overseas Market Preparation (OMP) Grant with reference ID 240799EZ. pairs.question: A company submitted a Change Request on 25 December 2025 to extend their Claim Due Date from 29 December 2025 because they have not completed the audit for their Enterprise Development Grant claim. The caller is enquiring about the status of this Change Request with reference number 241154BK-CR01.
pairs.expected_outcome: The caller understands that the Change Request requires time to process and knows the proper claim submission procedure, including the requirement to select an auditor from Enterprise Singapore's Pre-Qualified Panel and wait for Change Request approval before submitting the claim.
pairs.enquiry_text: 241154BK-CR01    Agency:Enterprise Singapore           Caller enquiring on the above Change Request submitted on   25 Dec 2025, to extend the Claim Due Date because they have not completed the Audit.Initial Claim Due Date: 29 Dec 2025        Caller enquiring on the status of the above Change Request.
pairs.answer_text:
The Change Request will require some time to process.
The company should have submitted the claim before the Claim Due Date.
During final claim submission in BGP, the company must select an auditor from Enterprise Singapore's Pre-Qualified Panel to verify the claims.
An Enterprise Singapore officer will verify that the project deliverables have been met.
The Enterprise Singapore officer may contact the company for further information if required.
A site visit or presentation meeting may be arranged for the purpose of verifying project deliverables.
The company may be asked to revise the Project Report if the information is incomplete.
The auditor that the company has appointed will verify the claim documents and issue an Audit Report upon completion of the verification.
The company should wait for the approval of the Change Request before submitting the claim.

claims.claim: The Change Request will require some time to process.
The company should have submitted the claim before the Claim Due Date.
During final claim submission in BGP, the company must select an auditor from Enterprise Singapore's Pre-Qualified Panel to verify the claims.
An Enterprise Singapore officer will verify that the project deliverables have been met.
The Enterprise Singapore officer may contact the company for further information if required.
A site visit or presentation meeting may be arranged for the purpose of verifying project deliverables.
The company may be asked to revise the Project Report if the information is incomplete.
The auditor that the company has appointed will verify the claim documents and issue an Audit Report upon completion of the verification.
The company should wait for the approval of the Change Request before submitting the claim.

pairs.question: A caller is enquiring on behalf of another company that shares the same directorship as their own company. The caller wants to know if there is POS support available and what the application steps are for such a grant.
pairs.expected_outcome: The caller understands that PSG grant supports POS systems, knows the key eligibility criteria to consider, knows where to find available solutions, and understands the application process through BGP.
pairs.enquiry_text: Caller wants to ask for another company if there are POS support that they can tap into. If have, what are the steps to apply for such a grant.    (Confirmed that DARSHNI'S PTE. LTD. and R6 CONSTRUCTION   PTE. LTD. share the same Directorship).
pairs.answer_text:
The PSG grant supports purchase of POS systems.
Callers can use the Solutions Directory on the GoBusiness site PSG page to look for available POS systems.
Callers must consider their SSIC Code for the Sector when looking at PSG solutions.
If the caller's sector is not listed in the Solutions Directory, the caller may consider grants indicated under the Generic (non-sector specific) section.
For PSG IT Solutions, callers have to get the solution as listed and from the Pre-Approved vendor.
PSG IT Solutions support is for the first time adoption of a solution.
If a company applied for that category of solution in the past, the company will not be able to get the PSG support.
The BGP User Guide for applying for PSG support can be found on the Enterprise SG site PSG page under the How to apply section Step 4.
The PSG application process includes confirming the solution wanted in the directory, then going to the BGP to make a submission for review and approval of the PO.

claims.claim: The PSG grant supports purchase of POS systems.
Callers can use the Solutions Directory on the GoBusiness site PSG page to look for available POS systems.
Callers must consider their SSIC Code for the Sector when looking at PSG solutions.
If the caller's sector is not listed in the Solutions Directory, the caller may consider grants indicated under the Generic (non-sector specific) section.
For PSG IT Solutions, callers have to get the solution as listed and from the Pre-Approved vendor.
PSG IT Solutions support is for the first time adoption of a solution.
If a company applied for that category of solution in the past, the company will not be able to get the PSG support.
The BGP User Guide for applying for PSG support can be found on the Enterprise SG site PSG page under the How to apply section Step 4.
The PSG application process includes confirming the solution wanted in the directory, then going to the BGP to make a submission for review and approval of the PO.

pairs.question: A company had their PSG claim submission rejected because they made payment to their vendor before submitting the application. Although the campaign activities only started after the application was approved, the payment timing violated PSG eligibility criteria. The company wants to appeal the rejection and needs confirmation of the appeal process to show their vendor, FY ADVERTISEMENT PTE. LTD.
pairs.expected_outcome: The user understands that their appeal request has been submitted and will be reviewed, knows the timeline for the appeal process, and receives confirmation that they will be contacted by email within the specified timeframe.
pairs.answer_text:
For PSG, applicants must not have made any form of payment, including deposits, for the solution they are applying for, as this is one of the main Eligibility Criteria.
The appeal is subject to approval and the timeline for the appeal approval and the data patch to reinstate the claim can take between 6 to 8 weeks upon receipt of complete documents.
The claims PO will reach out to the applicant via email in the next 2 weeks to start the appeal process.

The appeal is subject to approval and the timeline for the appeal approval and the data patch to reinstate the claim can take between 6 to 8 weeks upon receipt of complete documents.
The claims PO will reach out to the applicant via email in the next 2 weeks to start the appeal process.
